text:
Sam: incident-bot just paged for elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate from eu-west-1. Seeing ~12% error rate, customer impact reported by a single enterprise customer. logging: short spikes around 11:03 UTC.
incident-bot: [SEV2] Elevated 5xx rate on inference-router-eu (alerts: 5xx_rate > 5% for 5m). Pager: Sam, Cheng.
Cheng: jumping in. checking router logs + k8s events. anyone seen a deploy around that time?
Nina: not from platform deploys, CI shows no deploys in the last hour. product reports a rollback happened earlier but unrelated.
Elaine: I can pull a quick traffic breakdown by model if helpful.
Sam: yes please. rough customer impact: one slot of dedicated capacity experienced increased tail latency then 5xx. Could be K/V cache thrash or memory pressure.
Cheng: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-router -o wide` now. seeing one pod in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-eu-12. Crash logs show `OOMKilled` then `503 downstream`.
Mike: oncall note: gpu-eu-12 had an autoscaler event 10:58 that pushed a high-load batch. I'm seeing GPU mem utilization at 99% for that node.
Sam: temporary mitigation: drain traffic from that node, route to fallback pool in us-west for affected tenant. Can we trigger routing fallback?
Nina: doing routing policy override now: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west-1 --fallback-region us-west-2 --selector tenant=enterprise-42`
ops-bot: routing change applied by Nina at 11:12 UTC. New fallback in place, traffic shift ~95% within 40s.
Cheng: pod restarted cleanly once pulled from node. Still need to investigate why GPU memory spiked. uploading logs to /tmp/1793456789-gpulogs.tar.gz
Elaine: customer outreach: ProductOps wants to alert enterprise-42 with a brief note. Suggested: "We've applied a temporary routing change to maintain availability. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Approve?
Sam: +1. Keep it concise. also include timeline and expected follow-up window (T+24h).
incident-bot: Note added: mitigation (routing fallback) applied. Incident status: contained.
Sam: assigning owners for post-incident tasks: Cheng -> root cause and memory profile; Mike -> autoscaler policy review; Nina -> routing policy safeguards + test; Elaine -> customer comms + postmortem note; Sam -> runbook updates and brown-bag scheduling.
Cheng: initial hypothesis: a background cache warm job triggered heavy concurrent KV fetches and exceeded per-GPU memory due to memory leak in a new quantized kernel. I'll capture performance counters and heap traces.
Mike: autoscaler logs show burst threshold set to 400 tokens/s per GPU for that pool; might need smoothing. Will propose change and run canary tomorrow.
Nina: adding a policy that will prevent cross-tenant burst from exhausting a whole node: `route-shares` per-tenant cap + soft preemption. Will draft config.
Elaine: draft sent to product-ops for customer message. Will send once Sam approves.
Sam: approved. Please send at EOD. Also schedule postmortem review. I propose 24h timeline: postmortem doc by tomorrow EOD, review/brown-bag in 72h. Anyone object?
Cheng: fine. I'll file the postmortem and link logs.
Mike: fine. I'll add proposed autoscaler changes to the action items.
Nina: will add routing tests and a unit that simulates KV warm.
Elaine: will coordinate with customer success for outreach and follow-up.
Sam: creating tracking issue: ENG-OPS-7821 (postmortem + remediation + runbook). Please add discrete ACs and owners.
Cheng: added initial RCA section: `Symptom: OOMKilled on inference-router pod -> 5xx throttling. Probable cause: memory pressure triggered by concurrent KV warm job + newly deployed quantized kernel memory growth.`
Sam: action items (summary):
- Cheng: reproduce leak locally and provide trace (owner, due: +24h).
- Mike: propose autoscaler smoothing + canary (owner, due: +48h).
- Nina: routing policy hardening + integration test (owner, due: +72h).
- Elaine: customer communication + postmortem summary (owner, due: +24h).
- Sam: runbook update and schedule brown-bag (owner, due: +72h).
Please add estimated effort and mark blockers.
incident-bot: Incident state changed from CONTAINED -> INVESTIGATING by Sam at 11:30 UTC.
Nina: quick note: add a temporary alert to detect single-node-exhaustion pattern: `node_gpu_mem_exhaustion{region=\"eu-west-1\"} > 0` for 3m. I'll push it now.
ops-bot: new alert rule added by Nina.
Elaine: I've drafted the customer note and put it in ENG-OPS-7821/comments. Short bullet timeline + mitigation + next steps.
Sam: good. Let's also plan a 30m brown-bag for the platform team after the postmortem: topics: prevention patterns (per-tenant caps, autoscaler smoothing), how to write integration tests that emulate cache warms, and playbook updates. Prefer morning slot in two business days.
Cheng: can present the kernel memory profiling.
Mike: I'll cover autoscaler behavior and simulations.
Nina: will demo routing integration tests.
Elaine: I'll invite customer success for a segment on communications.
Sam: ok assigning calendar owner: Sam. I'll create the meeting invite after postmortem doc lands.
Cheng: quick reproducibility note in issue: `python scripts/run_kv_warm.py --concurrency 64 --model quantized-v2 --duration 10m` produced similar memory growth in local simulation. Dropping heap snapshots to /artifacts/1793456789/
Mike: added autoscaler tuning PR: `infra#4482` — please review, includes smoothing window changes and an experimental soft-preemption flag.
Nina: routing tests PR `platform#1029` open; CI includes a simulated tenant burst.
Elaine: postmortem draft uploaded. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/ENG-OPS-7821. Please add feedback inline.
Sam: thanks all. Final checklist before we close this thread: ensure postmortem has timeline + impact, action owners + due dates, and confirmation of brown-bag invite. Once that's done, I'll mark incident as CLOSED in the tracker.
Cheng: I'll update RCA with heap diff and attach kernel version that triggered the leak.
Mike: will run canary of autoscaler tuning in staging tonight.
Nina: will add the new alert runbook snippet to the oncall playbook.
Elaine: customer success will follow up after postmortem.
Sam: closing notes: good mitigation pace, clear handback, owners assigned. We'll use this as an opportunity to harden tenant isolation and autoscaler policies. Brown-bag to follow. :thumbsup:
